title: Fair Value Option - ASC 825
learning_objectives: Distinguish from required fair value measurement

content.definition: Irrevocable election to measure eligible financial assets and liabilities at fair value, with changes in fair value reported in net income
content.purpose: Reduce volatility in financial statements by allowing consistent measurement of related assets/liabilities, simplify hedge accounting
content.key_principle: OPTIONAL (not required). Once elected for an instrument, irrevocable.
eligible_instruments: Certain nonfinancial insurance contracts and warranties

election_timing.when: At acquisition/issuance, or upon certain events (reconsideration events)
election_timing.instrument_by_instrument: Applied to individual instruments, not all or nothing

accounting_treatment.interest_dividends: Report separately from fair value changes (or may report together)

without_fvo.financial_assets: May be classified as trading (FV through NI), AFS (FV through OCI), or held-to-maturity (amortized cost)

comparison_to_other_methods.with_fvo: Always fair value with changes through net income (like trading securities)

example_financial_asset.facts: Purchase AFS debt securities $100K. Elect FVO. Year-end FV $110K.
example_financial_asset.without_fvo: DR Investment $10K, CR OCI $10K (unrealized gain to OCI)
example_financial_asset.with_fvo: DR Investment $10K, CR Unrealized Gain (NI) $10K (unrealized gain to net income)
example_financial_asset.note: FVO removes AFS classification and OCI treatment

example_financial_liability.facts: Issue note payable $100K. Elect FVO. Year-end FV $95K (company's credit risk increased).
example_financial_liability.entry: DR Note Payable $5K, CR Gain on Change in FV (NI) $5K
example_financial_liability.counterintuitive: Company's credit worsens, liability FV decreases, recognize gain in NI

content.upfront_costs: Transaction costs and fees expensed immediately (not added to carrying amount like amortized cost method)
disclosure_requirements: Fair value and changes in fair value for items measured at FVO
Differences between fair value and contractual amounts
content.hedge_accounting_alternative: FVO can be used instead of complex hedge accounting if hedging relationship exists

own_credit_risk_for_liabilities.issue: If company's creditworthiness declines, liability FV decreases, recognize gain (counterintuitive)
own_credit_risk_for_liabilities.asc_825: Gain/loss reported in NI (no separate treatment for own credit)
own_credit_risk_for_liabilities.asc_815_note: Different rules for derivatives - own credit adjustments may go to OCI

cpa_exam_tips: FVO = OPTIONAL election to measure at FV with changes in NI
Eligible: Financial assets/liabilities. Ineligible: Subsidiaries, leases, equity method investments
Changes in FV go to NET INCOME (not OCI)
Similar to trading securities treatment (FV through NI)
Counterintuitive for liabilities: Credit worsens → FV decreases → Gain in NI

key_points: Fair value option: Optional, irrevocable election to measure at FV with changes in NI
Eligible: Financial assets/liabilities. Ineligible: Subsidiaries, leases, equity method
Changes in FV reported in NET INCOME (not OCI)
Similar to trading securities (FV through NI) for assets
